item.title: Registered full-time employment up 4.1 per cent in August 2025
item.description: Registered full-time employment in the private sector went up by 9,490 persons to 243,998; public sector full-time employment increased by 2,195 persons to 54,740

item.title: Agriculture Ministry launches damage assessment after Storm Harry hits farmers
item.description: Farmers are being asked to submit geotagged photos of storm damage by Friday through the Biedja Cam platform, as the government begins assessing losses that could form the basis of an EU-backed aid scheme

item.title: IHI to sell 72 per cent of five-star Corinthia Hotel Lisbon
item.description: IHI, which currently owns 100% of the asset, will retain a 28 oer cent interest in the joint venture

item.title: Abela misrepresents youth home ownership figures, Opposition claims
item.description: Opposition says prime minister misleading public by citing household data as individual statistics

item.title: Porchetta with pumpkin mash and salsa verde
item.description: Fresh from the cover of Gourmet Today magazine, Villa Corinthia's Francesco Mazzei shares a refined porchetta with pumpkin mash, cavolo nero and salsa verde, Italian comfort elevated with signature finesse and elegance

item.title: Central Bank appoints first woman deputy governor
item.description: Prime minister says appointment marks highest financial sector position ever held by Maltese woman

item.title: No major injuries, emergency services responded to nearly 300 incidents during Storm Harry
item.description: Home Affairs Minister Byron Camilleri tells parliament that there were no major or fatal incidents despite the widespread damage during Storm Harry

item.title: Lands Authority scraps Fortina valuations, orders fresh assessment in clash with NAO
item.description: The Lands Authority told parliament’s Public Accounts Committee it will restart the valuation of Fortina’s controversial change-of-use concession, rejecting previous assessments

item.title: Planning Commission rejects Paola Church cafeteria proposal
item.description: The Planning Authority has refused a proposal by the Paola parish to open a small cafeteria within the Christ the King Basilica complex, citing concerns that it would disrupt the historic building’s architectural symmetry and visual amenity

item.title: In the shadow of Trump’s Greenland threats Maltese MEPs call for EU unity
item.description: EU leaders will get together in Brussels for an emergency summit on Thursday to discuss a way forward in an international order that has been upended.
